queries: INSERT INTO public.gregale_pipeline_gates(id,intent,expires_at) VALUES ($1,$2::jsonb,clock_timestamp()+($3::bigint*interval '1 millisecond')) ON CONFLICT (id) DO NOTHING RETURNING jsonb_build_object('intent',intent,'expires_at',to_char(expires_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC','YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.MS"Z"'),'decision',decision,'delivery',delivery) AS record

UPDATE public.gregale_pipeline_gates SET decision=CASE WHEN decision IS NULL AND expires_at<=clock_timestamp() THEN jsonb_build_object('state','expired','actor_id',NULL,'payload',NULL,'decided_at',to_char(clock_timestamp() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC','YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.MS"Z"')) ELSE decision END WHERE id=$1 RETURNING jsonb_build_object('intent',intent,'expires_at',to_char(expires_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC','YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.MS"Z"'),'decision',decision,'delivery',delivery) AS record

UPDATE public.gregale_pipeline_gates SET decision=CASE WHEN expires_at<=clock_timestamp() THEN jsonb_build_object('state','expired','actor_id',NULL,'payload',NULL,'decided_at',to_char(clock_timestamp() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC','YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.MS"Z"')) ELSE $3::jsonb || jsonb_build_object('decided_at',to_char(clock_timestamp() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC','YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.MS"Z"')) END WHERE id=$1 AND intent->>'binding_sha256'=$2 AND decision IS NULL RETURNING jsonb_build_object('intent',intent,'expires_at',to_char(expires_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC','YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.MS"Z"'),'decision',decision,'delivery',delivery) AS record

UPDATE public.gregale_pipeline_gates SET delivery=$3 WHERE id=$1 AND decision=$2::jsonb RETURNING jsonb_build_object('intent',intent,'expires_at',to_char(expires_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC','YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.MS"Z"'),'decision',decision,'delivery',delivery) AS record

UPDATE public.gregale_pipeline_gates SET checked_at=clock_timestamp() WHERE id IN (SELECT id FROM public.gregale_pipeline_gates WHERE delivery='pending' AND intent->'scope'=$2::jsonb AND intent->>'pipeline_sha256'=$3 AND intent->>'contract_sha256'=$4 ORDER BY (decision IS NULL AND expires_at>clock_timestamp()),checked_at,expires_at,id LIMIT $1 FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED) RETURNING jsonb_build_object('intent',intent,'expires_at',to_char(expires_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC','YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.MS"Z"'),'decision',decision,'delivery',delivery) AS record

SELECT jsonb_build_object('intent',intent,'expires_at',to_char(expires_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC','YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.MS"Z"'),'decision',decision,'delivery',delivery) AS record FROM public.gregale_pipeline_gates WHERE intent->>'workflow_run_id'=$1 AND intent->>'owner_id'=$2 ORDER BY id LIMIT 100
